theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_unit_orientation_pairing
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ξ : MultiVector P n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 ∧ ξ β = 1
